name: Divine Charge tramples enemies within Divine Trample's 3 yd DBC radius only
contract: Divine Charge 527023 reads 'causing them to trample nearby enemies'. Every 0.5 sec its aura 527270 searches enemies around each mounted member and casts Divine Trample 527269 on them; the owner ruled on 2026-11-10 that 'nearby' is 527269's own EffectRadiusIndex[0] 15 (SpellRadius RadiusMin = RadiusMax 3.0 yd in the server DBC set), not the earlier 5 yd literal.
The search is IsWithinDistInMap, which adds both combat reaches: the Templar (1.5) and each Harvest Golem (1.275) widen 3 yd to 5.775 yd between centres and the old 5 yd to 7.775 yd.
The near golem stands 4.0 yd away (1.225 yd past both reaches, inside 3 yd) and must be trampled; the far golem stands 6.75 yd away (3.975 yd past both reaches, between 3 and 5 yd) and must not be.
